banner.note: New project. First commit after the 14 November start. Planning notes are in /preparation.
hero.title: Stablecoins in and out of Bitcoin Cash.
hero.sub.none: Each flow opens here once it has been measured on mainnet. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap: Swap BCH and PUSD through Cauldron pools, signed in your own wallet. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.land: Send BCH from any wallet or exchange to your landing address and it arrives as PUSD, or comes back to you. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.cross: Bring {symbols} in as PUSD in your BCH wallet, and send PUSD out as {symbols}. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap-land: Swap BCH and PUSD through Cauldron pools, signed in your own wallet. Or send BCH from any wallet or exchange to your landing address and it arrives as PUSD. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap-cross: Swap BCH and PUSD on Bitcoin Cash, bring {symbols} in as PUSD, and send PUSD out as {symbols}. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.land-cross: Bring in BCH from any wallet or exchange, or {symbols} from another chain, as PUSD in your BCH wallet. Send PUSD out as {symbols}. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.swap-land-cross: Swap BCH and PUSD, land BCH as PUSD, and move {symbols} in and out as PUSD. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.honest: On Bitcoin Cash every step is a transaction you sign, or a contract that can only pay you. The crossing between chains is carried by {route}.

how.title: How Sampan works
how.lead: Every step is a Bitcoin Cash transaction you can look up in an explorer. The Sampan server holds no key and never signs for you.
how.land.title: Landing address
how.land.text: You get the address of a small contract. BCH that reaches it can leave in only two ways, both to your address: converted to {symbol} in Cauldron pools at no less than the minimum rate fixed in the address, or, once the coin is {blocks} blocks old, given back as BCH.
how.swap.title: Swap on BCH
how.swap.text: Your wallet signs one transaction that trades with Cauldron pools. Before your wallet sees it, the page checks every output: each one pays you or goes back to a pool it rebuilt, and nothing else is allowed.
how.cross.title: Between chains
how.cross.text: {route} carries the value between Bitcoin Cash and {symbols} on Base. Going out, your {symbol} is swapped to BCH in Cauldron pools and handed to {route}. Coming in, the BCH that arrives goes to a landing address of the same contract.

how.source.text: This is the whole contract, as compiled into every landing address. No key of the service appears in it.
how.source.link: Open the file in the repository
how.verify.title: Verify a landing address yourself
how.verify.text: Download the recovery card from the status page of your landing. Then, in a copy of the source code, run:
how.verify.after: It compiles the contract from source and checks that it gives the same address as the card.
how.finish.title: Who can finish a landing
how.finish.text: Anyone. The contract checks where the coins go, not who sends the transaction. The Sampan server finishes landings by itself. If it stops, this script does the same from any computer, using public Electrum servers and the public Cauldron indexer:
how.exists.title: What already exists and what this adds
how.exists.cauldron: The Cauldron app has an X-chain tab that swaps plain BCH with other chains through THORChain. Its code does not send CashTokens to the cross-chain vault.
how.exists.paytaca: Paytaca has Cash In, which gets you BCH by converting other coins through SideShift or by buying from peers.
how.exists.gap: In both, getting to {symbol} is a second swap.
how.adds.title: What Sampan adds
how.adds.land: A landing address that turns any BCH that reaches it into {symbol} for its owner, or gives it back.
how.adds.cross: {symbols} on Base to {symbol} as one flow.
